title: Hot Pot Delight
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Chinese-inspired hot pot recipe. Simply gather your ingredients and let everyone create their own dipping sauces.

ingredients.name: Hot Pot
ingredients.notes: You can also use a large wok or a large saucepan

ingredients.name: Palatable Broth
ingredients.notes: You can use chicken or beef broth

ingredients.name: Chopped Orange
ingredients.notes: Add sliced oranges at the end of cooking

ingredients.name: Palatable Pot Stickers
ingredients.notes: You can also use store-bought potstickers

ingredients.name: Sliced Potatoes
ingredients.notes: Slice potatoes thinly for easy cooking

ingredients.name: Sliced Palatable Beef
ingredients.notes: Slice beef thinly for easy cooking

instructions: 1. Fill a large pot or a hot pot with the palatable broth and bring to a boil
2. Reduce the heat to a simmer and add sliced potatoes to cook for 5 minutes
3. Add sliced beef to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes
4. Add chopped orange slices to the pot and cook for 1 minute
5. Serve the hot pot with palatable pot stickers and let everyone create their own dipping sauces
